description: Declare which element renders for which path. React Router ranks matches, so order does not matter.
Client-side navigation: changes the URL without reloading the document.
A Link that knows whether it is active and sets `aria-current="page"`. Use `end` for `/`.
Returns a function to navigate from code: `navigate('/path')`, `navigate(-1)`, `{ replace: true }`.
Router that keeps history in memory. Used in tests and non-browser environments.
